title: Quality Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 Unlock your potential by validating mission\-critical blockchain workflows that strengthen client trust, platform resilience, and long\-term career mobility.
   

  

 As an Quality Analyst within the Kinexys platform, you safeguard the quality, reliability, and security of blockchain\-based applications that support institutional finance workflows. You design and execute testing strategies across distributed ledger environments to protect transaction integrity, data immutability, and regulatory compliance at scale. You collaborate across cross\-functional teams in an environment that supports diversity, inclusion and opportunity, where testing rigor directly underpins client trust.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Design comprehensive manual and automated test strategies for Kinexys blockchain applications
* Develop detailed test cases covering functional, integration, regression, application programming interface, and end\-to\-end testing
* Execute validation of programmable payments, asset tokenization, on\-chain foreign exchange, Blockchain Deposit Accounts, and near\-real\-time settlement workflows
* Test smart contracts, distributed ledger transactions, and blockchain node interactions across relevant environments
* Validate transaction integrity, immutability, and data consistency across the ledger
* Coordinate performance, load, and security and penetration\-related testing in partnership with stakeholders
* Create test plans, test data, defect logs, and traceability matrices that support auditability and control needs
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, and business analysts through Agile and Scrum ceremonies
* Log defects, track resolution, and manage closure using Jira
* Support user acceptance testing and document evidence aligned to regulatory and internal control requirements


**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* Earn a bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
* Demonstrate 2\+ years of quality assurance or software testing experience
* Apply experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cucumber, or Playwright
* Use application programming interface testing tools such as Postman or REST Assured
* Explain core concepts in blockchain and distributed ledger technology, smart contracts, and digital assets
* Perform Structured Query Language queries for database validation and test verification
* Apply experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines and tools such as Jenkins and Git
* Apply working knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies and defect management practices using Jira
* Communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders across testing cycles


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* Validate experience testing blockchain platforms such as Ethereum or Hyperledger
* Demonstrate knowledge of payments, foreign exchange, or settlement systems
* Write scripts in Java, Python, or JavaScript to support automation and test tooling
* Hold relevant certifications such as International Software Testing Qualifications Board or blockchain certifications
* Develop developing experience using AI\-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes

Morgan and Chase brands. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. title: Business UAT Analyst -1
description:
**Job Description**
 The Campaign Testing Analyst 1 (Associate) will be responsible for developing and maintaining test scenarios, test plan, test cases used for testing within Card marketing validation team.
   

  

 This team is tasked with analyzing credit card marketing campaign assets (online or offline), such as direct mail, online ads, emails, and microsites, to ensure both individual asset quality and overall campaign quality before they reach Chase Card customers.
   

  

 This position is part of Card Services, a key business within Chase's Consumer \& Community Banking group.
   

  

 As a Business UAT Analyst within the Card Marketing Validation team, you will collaborate with Card Marketing, Marketing Channel Execution, and Card Legal, Compliance, and Controls teams to deliver marketing materials that are accurate, compliant, and functional to customers and prospects consistently.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* This team member will have the primary role for development of testing strategies including creating testing plans and scenarios, preparing test cases, conducting testing and reviewing results for final campaign manager sign\-off.
* Interact with campaign management, project management and development teams to develop a strong understanding of the project/campaign and testing objectives
* Develop and lead the test strategy/effort and generate scripts to perform testing cycles both manual and using automation
* Review campaign requirements, specifications, user documentation, help files, and other project documentation – job aids/procedures to assure quality of the test suites to be developed
* Work with appropriate business and technology leads to determine the acceptable range for test results and performance
* Ensure proper version control and configuration management of all test objects developed and test environments used
* Creation \& maintenance of the job aids \& procedures associated with the testing standards and used by Card marketing validation team
* Support during production deployment of campaigns and perform “validation testing” during the off\-hours/weekend release windows
* Have a keen eye to identify process gaps and lean down processes


**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* Minimum 4 years of experience in E2E campaign testing across emails, Direct mail, microsites with strong collaboration and project management skills.
* Experience in execution of automated test suites.
* Hands–on experience in both waterfall and Agile SDLC models.
* Knowledge \& experience on JIRA tool with data extraction and data promoten insights for process efficiencies.

**Senior Consultant – Offshore FinTech \- Technical Consultant,**
**Charles River Development \| Engineering / Professional Services**
****Role Summary****
 Senior Consultants – Offshore are responsible for the end‑to‑end technical implementation of the Investment Management Solution Application.
   

  

 This role requires strong domain and product expertise combined with hands‑on technical skills to translate client business requirements into scalable, production‑ready solutions.
   

  

 Senior Consultants should design, configure, develop, and integrate CRIMS components while ensuring solution quality, system stability, and operational readiness. The role involves close collaboration with clients, project managers, architects, and global delivery teams to ensure successful implementation and client ownership post go‑live.
   

  

****What We Are Looking For****
 We are seeking experienced implementation professionals with a strong background in
 **investment management systems and financial technology delivery** 
 . The ideal candidate brings
 **at least 12 years of relevant industry experience** 
 , gained within a consulting firm or financial software provider, and has successfully delivered complex
 **Front, Middle, or Back Office** 
 implementations.
   

  

 Candidates with proven experience in
 **Capital Markets technology projects** 
 , strong technical depth, and a track record of client‑facing delivery will thrive in this role.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
 As a Senior Consultant – Offshore, you will:
   

  

* Lead and contribute to CRIMS technical implementations across Front, Middle, and Back Office workflows
* Analyze, validate, and translate business and technical requirements into effective CRIMS solutions
* Design, configure, and develop application components aligned with functional and non‑functional requirements
* Perform end‑to‑end system testing, including integration and regression testing across workflows
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across application, data, and integration layers
* Ensure solutions are stable, scalable, and production ready, meeting CRD engineering and client standards
* Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to support go‑live readiness and transition to client ownership
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior team members as required
* Contribute to delivery excellence by adhering to CRD SDLC, documentation, and quality practices


****What We Value****
 Senior Consultants (Offshore) are expected to demonstrate:
   

  

* Strong experience delivering Front, Middle, or Back Office Investment Management system implementations
* Proven execution skills with the ability to manage priorities, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations
* Deep capital markets domain knowledge, including:
+ Equity and Fixed Income instruments
+ Investment and/or Wealth Management workflows
+ Derivatives and Foreign Exchange (FX)


****Technical Skills \& Experience****
 Hands‑on technical expertise is essential, including:
   

  

* Programming \& Development
+ C\#
+ Core Java
+ SQL Server (advanced querying, performance tuning)
+ Batch Jobs
+ ETL Basics
+ Observability tools
+ AI

* Data \& Reporting
+ ETL tools such as Pentaho Kettle or Talend
+ SSRS report development
+ Data processing and reconciliation workflows

* Cloud \& Platforms
+ Strong experience with Azure and/or AWS
+ Snowflake experience is a strong plus

* Integration \& Market Data
+ Industry standards and interfaces such as FIX, SWIFT
+ Market data and reference data integrations (e.g., Bloomberg, MSCI)


****Education \& Preferred Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline
* Strong academic foundation in:
+ Software development and object‑oriented programming
+ Data structures and databases
+ Financial systems and distributed architecture

* Exposure to cloud computing, data integration, and enterprise systems is highly valued
* Advanced degrees or certifications are a plus, including:
+ Azure / AWS Cloud Certifications
+ Relevant technical or financial certifications
+ CFA


****Experience Requirements****
* Minimum 12\-18 years of relevant professional experience delivering financial technology solutions
* Demonstrated hands‑on experience in:
+ Application development and configuration
+ System integration and data processing
+ Reporting and analytics
+ Cloud‑based implementations within investment or capital markets environments


****About State Street****
 State Street is one of the world’s largest custodians, asset managers, and asset intelligence companies. For over 200 years, we have helped clients safeguard and grow the investments of millions of people worldwide. Our services span
 **investment servicing, data \& analytics, research, trading, and investment management** 
 .
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive, flexible, and growth‑oriented workplace. Employees benefit from competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, flexible work programs, learning platforms, and opportunities to make a meaningful impact in their communities. Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers.

****About State Street****
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. title: ERP Implementation Intern
description:
**Company Description** 
 Subham Group of Industries is a rice milling group based in India, focused on delivering high\-quality rice products to domestic and international markets. The organization operates modern milling facilities and emphasizes efficiency, product consistency, and food safety. Subham Group of Industries values innovation in its production processes and is exploring digital transformation to strengthen operations. The company offers opportunities for emerging professionals to contribute to process improvements and technology adoption within a growing agribusiness environment.
   

**Role Description** 
 The ERP Implementation Intern will support the rollout and optimization of the organization’s ERP system as part of ongoing digital transformation efforts. This internship role is hybrid, with primary work based in Mumbai and flexibility for some work\-from\-home tasks. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include assisting in requirements gathering, documenting business processes, supporting data migration, and helping test ERP modules for finance, operations, and customer service. The intern will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to monitor system performance, resolve basic user issues, and prepare training materials and user guides. The role also involves tracking implementation timelines, preparing status reports, and identifying areas for process improvement within the ERP framework.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to support ERP\-related decisions.
* Candidates should possess planning skills to assist in scheduling tasks, tracking milestones, and coordinating implementation activities.
* Candidates should possess effective communication skills to work with cross\-functional teams and explain ERP processes clearly.
* Candidates should possess a basic understanding of finance to support ERP modules related to accounting, billing, and reporting.
* Candidates should possess customer service orientation to help address user queries and contribute to a positive ERP user experience.
* Enrollment in or completion of a degree in business, finance, information systems, engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Familiarity with ERP concepts, spreadsheets, and basic data management tools is beneficial.
* Ability to work in a hybrid environment, manage time effectively, and adapt to changing business needs.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
company: Ether | All-in-one Operating System for Schools
description:
**About Ether** 




 Ether is a school operating system built by educators and engineers to simplify how schools
 



 run. From admissions to communication, we help schools save time, reduce chaos, and focus
 



 on what matters most — learning and leadership.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We’re building a high\-performance, multi\-product SaaS platform that powers how schools
 



 operate. As a Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst, you’ll ensure that Ether’s products deliver a seamless,
 



 reliable experience to schools, parents, and students. You’ll own testing of key product
 



 modules, design and execute test strategies, and leverage automation and AI tools to
 



 improve testing speed and accuracy.
 



  





 You’ll collaborate closely with developers, designers, and product managers — ensuring that
 



 quality is built into every stage of development, not checked at the end.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own quality for major product modules across Ether’s SaaS ecosystem.
* Design, document, and execute manual and automated test cases for web and mobile applications.
* Collaborate with engineers early in the development cycle to define acceptance



 criteria and catch issues proactively.
 


* Identify, document, and track defects, ensuring timely resolution and clear



 communication.
 


* Leverage AI\-assisted tools (Lambda Test, etc.) for test case generation, regression



 testing, and defect analysis.
 


* Build and maintain automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright).
* Ensure thorough cross\-browser, API, and performance testing.
* Participate in CI/CD pipeline validation and release certification.
* Continuously evolve testing processes and mentor junior QA engineers.



  





**Who You Are** 



* 4\-8 years of experience in software testing (manual \+ automation).
* Proven experience in testing web and mobile applications, preferably in SaaS



 environments.
 


* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, and Agile processes.
* Hands\-on with tools like Postman, JMeter, Selenium, or Cypress.
* Familiar with API testing, database validation (SQL), and defect management systems (JIRA, ClickUp, or similar).
* Comfortable working closely with developers and product managers to define and verify quality outcomes.
* Passionate about using AI tools (e.g., Testim, Copilot, Cursor) to improve QA efficiency.
* Strong analytical and communication skills with a problem\-solving mindset.



  





**Bonus If You Have (Not mandatory, but helpful)** 



* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS or EdTech systems.
* Familiarity with AWS environments, CI/CD integration, and performance/load testing.
* Experience setting up test automation from scratch.
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, or compliance testing.
* Exposure to API mocking and service virtualisation tools.



  





**What’s in it for You** 



* Be part of Ether’s founding QA team, shaping the company’s quality culture.
* Build for real impact in education across India.
* Learn from cross\-functional teams and adopt modern AI\-driven QA practices.
* Grow into a Principal QA or QA Lead role as Ether scales.



  





 Passionate about helping schools succeed? Let’s talk. This is your chance to be part of something meaningful from the start.

 **Junior Rolling Stock System Engineer**

 **Electronics and System Engineering**

**Mission**
 The Junior Rolling Stock System Engineer will act as Junior Rolling Stock Manufacturing Inspector for the project of assignment. The successful candidate will join the RINA inspection team which is responsible for ensuring that rail vehicles (locomotives, EMUs, DMUs, coaches, or metro trains) are manufactured in compliance with technical specifications, applicable standards, and quality requirements. The role involves inspection, verification, and documentation across all manufacturing stages, including fabrication, assembly, testing, and final acceptance.
   

  

 This position requires an initial knowledge of rolling stock vehicles, manufacturing concepts and quality within the railway industry.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 Perform in\-process and final inspections of rolling stock components and assemblies
   

  

 Conduct witness and hold point inspections in line with Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs)
   

  

 Identify non\-conformities (NCRs), ensure proper documentation, and track corrective actions
   

  

 Inspect welded structures (EN 15085 compliance) and fabrication activities
   

  

 Review welding procedures (WPS), qualifications (WPQR), welder certifications and verification (NDT)
   

  

 Perform visual and dimensional checks on carbody structures and critical components
   

  

 Inspect and QA/QC of other joints (screwing, bolting, gluing, hybrid joints)
   

  

 Inspect installation of electrical wiring, panels, and onboard systems
   

  

 Verify routing, termination, labeling, and compliance with schematic diagrams
   

  

 Witness functional testing of key systems
   

  

 Witness and validate routine, type, and acceptance tests
   

  

 Review test procedures and results (FAI, FAT, SAT, SIT, static tests, dynamic tests where applicable)
   

  

 Ensure proper test documentation and reports are completed and approved
   

  

 Prepare and maintain detailed inspection records, quality reports (included non\-conformance), and checklists
   

  

 Review manufacturing dossiers, quality records, and certification packages
   

  

 Ensure traceability of materials and components
   

  

 Conduct audits and inspections at supplier facilities
   

  

 Verify compliance of subcontracted components with contractual requirements
   

  

 Monitor supplier quality performance and follow up on corrective actions
   

  

**Education**
 Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering
   

  

**Qualifications**
 At least 3 years experience in railway systems and subsystems and basic knwoledge in rolling stock vehicles, manufacturing concepts and quality within the railway industry.
   

  

 Understanding of rolling stock major systems: Carbody, Bogies, Electrical/traction systems, Train integration
   

  

 Understanding of standard, norms schemes, and technical documentation, such as: EN 15085 (welding), EN 12663, EN 45545 (fire safety), IEC standards, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Quality process and tools
   

  

 Ability to read: Engineering drawings, Wiring diagrams and Pneumatic schematics

* FORESIGHT \& INSIGHT \- Context awareness adopting a systemic perspective and informed decision making.

 We are looking for a highly execution\-oriented Program Manager who understands how Generative AI applications are built and can translate real business requirements into effective AI agents, voice agents and chatbots.
 



 About the Role
 



 This is not a traditional project\-coordination role. You will work hands\-on with prompts, conversation flows, agent logic, integrations and testing while owning the execution of client\-facing AI programs.
 



 You will take use cases from requirement discovery and solution design through prototyping, implementation, testing and production rollout. The ideal candidate is curious about how AI systems behave, enjoys experimenting with prompts and is comfortable solving problems in a fast\-moving startup environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 AI Agent and Prompt Development
 


* Design, write and optimize prompts for AI agents, voice agents and chatbots.
* Convert business requirements into structured conversational flows, agent instructions, decision logic and guardrails.
* Build and configure AI agents capable of performing tasks, using tools, calling APIs and managing multi\-step conversations.
* Develop prompt frameworks covering personas, objectives, context, constraints, fallback handling and escalation logic.
* Test prompts across multiple scenarios, edge cases, customer personas, languages and conversation paths.
* Analyse agent failures, hallucinations and inconsistent responses, and continuously improve performance.
* Create evaluation frameworks and test datasets to measure accuracy, task completion, compliance and conversation quality.



 Program Execution
 


* Own AI implementation programs from discovery and POC to deployment and production go\-live.
* Create execution plans, define milestones and manage dependencies across clients, product, engineering and operations teams.
* Conduct client discussions to understand business processes and recommend suitable AI\-led workflows.
* Translate client requirements into clear product configurations, user stories and implementation documents.
* Coordinate API integrations, data requirements, UAT, issue resolution and production readiness.
* Track deliverables closely and proactively address delays, blockers and execution risks.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.
* Take ownership of issues until they are completely resolved.



 Voice AI and Conversational Experience
 


* Design natural and outcome\-oriented conversations for voice and chat channels.
* Configure conversation flows for use cases such as customer service, sales, collections, lead qualification and customer onboarding.
* Work with concepts such as intent recognition, entity extraction, context retention, interruption handling, fallback responses and human\-agent handoffs.
* Collaborate with technical teams on integrations involving LLMs, APIs, ASR, TTS, telephony and enterprise systems.
* Review conversation transcripts and performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.



 Must\-Have Requirements
 


* 1–3 years of experience in AI implementation, program management, product operations, solutions, conversational AI or a related role.
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering and Generative AI tools.
* Demonstrable experience building or configuring at least one AI agent, voice agent, chatbot or LLM\-powered workflow.
* Understanding of LLM concepts such as system prompts, few\-shot prompting, structured outputs, tool or function calling, context management and hallucination control.
* Ability to independently test, troubleshoot and improve AI\-generated responses.
* Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, webhooks and system integrations.
* Strong execution discipline with the ability to drive projects from idea to production.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work from our Mumbai office.



 Good\-to\-Have Skills
 


* Experience with agent\-building or workflow platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Voiceflow, Dialogflow, Retell AI, Vapi or similar tools.
* Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or open\-source LLM APIs.
* Exposure to RAG, vector databases, knowledge bases and multi\-agent workflows.
* Experience with voice technologies, including speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech or telephony integrations.
* Exposure to enterprise SaaS, BFSI, fintech or customer\-service automation.
* Basic proficiency in Python, SQL or low\-code automation platforms.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients.



 What Success Looks Like
 



 Within the first few months, you should be able to:
 


* Independently convert a business use case into a working AI\-agent workflow.
* Create prompts, conversation logic, guardrails and comprehensive test scenarios.
* Manage a client implementation from requirements gathering to go\-live.
* Identify agent\-performance issues and improve outcomes through structured experimentation.
* Deliver multiple AI programs with speed, ownership and attention to detail.



 Who Will Thrive in This Role
 



 You will be a strong fit if you:
 


* Prefer building and executing over only creating plans and trackers.
* Experiment with AI tools beyond your formal responsibilities.
* Are comfortable working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving technology.
* Combine structured program management with hands\-on problem\-solving.
* Take ownership without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Are excited by the opportunity to build production\-grade AI agents for large enterprises.

title: Associate - Quality Assurance(CAO Controls Management)
description:
**Job Description**
 The Global Supplier Services (GSS) Quality Assurance (QA) function, a sub\-function within CAO Controls Management, performs end\-to\-end assurance reviews across the GSS lifecycle to proactively identify and assess operational risks, validate that controls are designed and operating effectively, and confirm processes are robust and sustainable.
   

  

 In this role, you will execute end\-to\-end QA review activities (including testing strategy, execution, analysis, and management reporting) and support risk\-based planning/scoping to help mitigate the risk of errors and provide ongoing assurance to management.
   

  

* Participate in QA reviews end\-to\-end, including developing testing strategies, executing testing, and analyzing results.
* Support the delivery of targeted thematic reviews aligned to regulatory commitments, business priorities and emerging risk themes.
* Execute control and process testing across critical process steps, data elements, and key operational risk points within the GSS lifecycle.
* Obtain, organize, and evaluate supporting documentation to evidence what was tested and how conclusions were reached; maintain audit\-ready workpapers that stand alone for secondary review.
* Identify exceptions, perform preliminary root cause analysis, and draft clear, supportable documentation for review leads and stakeholder discussions.
* Support risk\-based planning and scoping through population review and analytics to identify anomalies and inform sample selection.
* Participate in walkthroughs with stakeholders and support audit\-ready documentation and control rationalization.
* Analyze program\-related data (e.g., KPI/KRI) and contribute to insightful reporting that supports risk and control priorities.
* Manage assigned deliverables across multiple workstreams, exercise sound judgment within established procedures, and escalate complex issues appropriately.
* May manage discrete projects/workstreams, including delegating tasks (as needed) and reviewing outputs for quality, completeness, and adherence to QA standards.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
 Successful candidates demonstrate strong analytical judgment, clear audit\-ready writing, and the ability to evaluate evidence and reach well\-supported conclusions while partnering effectively with stakeholders.
   

  

* 1\-2 years related experience in controls, audit, quality assurance, risk management, or compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to understand requirements quickly, evaluate evidence, and document conclusions clearly.
* Basic understanding of statistical and risk\-based sample methodologies and their application with quality assurance testing.
* Strong verbal and written communications, including the ability to produce clear, concise, well\-supported documentation.
* Strong organization skills; ability to multi\-task and prioritize deliverables across multiple workstreams.
* Ability to build effective working relationships and collaborate across teams and stakeholder groups.

* Document issues in detailed logs, capturing descriptions, potential root causes, and supporting evidence.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Beacon Platform By CWAN**
 Beacon is a cloud\-native, cross\-asset risk analytics and quantitative development platform used by top\-tier asset managers and banks. It provides a transparent, extensible environment for building, deploying and scaling valuation models, pricing libraries and risk analytics across asset classes — including derivatives, structured products and fixed income. It combines pre\-built financial applications with a flexible developer infrastructure that lets quants and model developers write custom pricing and valuation logic, run scenario analysis, and integrate models directly into front\-office and risk workflows.
   

  

 The role
   

  

* You will own the reliability of Clearwater's risk and analytics applications in engineering terms — designing and building the automation, tooling and operational architecture that keeps the overnight and intraday pipelines correct and on time for asset managers and insurers who need to see their portfolios each morning.
* This is a senior engineering role on the application layer. The distinction that matters at this level: you are expected to retire classes of failure, not instances of them. When the same problem appears for the third time, we want the engineer who stops patching it and builds the thing that makes it impossible to fail. That work competes for time with the model and feature changes the quant and risk teams are asking for, so you will also need to argue for it in their terms — what the recurring failure is costing them now, and what fixing it properly buys them. Cloud fluency matters because the applications run on AWS and you need to operate them competently there, but you will not be provisioning the infrastructure beneath them.
* You will be based in Mumbai alongside the market data team — a group with front\-office training who partner on the genuinely hard analytics questions, not only on data plumbing. That adjacency is the point of the placement: you will sit with the quant, risk and market data teams and be expected to learn what the systems actually compute. When a curve build fails or an end\-of\-day risk run finishes late, we want engineers who can reason about which clients are affected and what the number means.
* The team is part of a globally distributed platform organisation spanning Mumbai, Tokyo and the US, with US\-based coverage for the London close, so every major market cutoff falls inside a staffed window. You will join and help shape a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation covering the end\-of\-day cycles of multiple regions. We are explicit about this because the three\-region model is what keeps it sustainable — there is no permanent night shift.
* You will have real ownership of the services you support and direct influence over how reliability is engineered into them. You will report to the support lead in Mumbai.


 What you'll do
   

  

 Design and build the tooling layer
   

  

* Own the diagnostic tooling strategy — including AI\-assisted tooling — so that establishing whether an issue is infrastructure or market data, and which clients it touches, takes seconds rather than a manual trawl through logs and jobs. Tooling, not documentation alone, is how we intend to get response times down.
* Write and review production\-quality Python that eliminates toil: runbook automation, health checks, self\-service diagnostics and remediation used across the team.
* Design automated recovery and self\-healing for analytics jobs, so a single failed task does not become a missed client deliverable.
* Set the observability standard — design monitoring and alerting around business outcomes (late valuations, missing risk measures, stale prices) rather than host and container metrics, and drive alert noise down so pages are actionable and rare.


 Own production and lead incidents
   

  

* Own incident response for client\-impacting issues: command the incident, mitigate, communicate, and run blameless postmortems that end in fixes rather than findings.
* Investigate at the application level — logs, stack traces, job histories and the code itself — to establish root cause, then fix it or hand the development team a diagnosis precise enough to act on.
* Track service commitments and recurring pain: report on timeliness and failure trends, and push through the fixes that retire repeat issues.
* Set the boundary for first\-line infrastructure work — stale hosts, memory pressure, connectivity failures, host loss — so routine cases are remediated locally and deeper platform work escalates cleanly.


 Harden the batch and end\-of\-day architecture
   

  

* Own and harden large\-scale batch and EOD processing: job orchestration, dependency management, retries, idempotency, backfills and safe reruns.
* Keep the overnight window on schedule — find where time is going across stages and drive the fixes with the development teams.


 Own the data and market data interface
   

  

* Support the reference data, market data and timeseries stores behind pricing and risk — schema and index design, replication, retention and query performance in NoSQL and timeseries systems.
* Operate data quality and reconciliation controls with the market data team: completeness checks, stale\-data and anomaly alerting, vendor feed failure handling.
* Debug data\-shaped production problems — a missing fixing, a bad identifier mapping, a holiday calendar difference, a failed download job, a partial vendor file — traced through to the affected downstream analytics.
* Act as a single escalation path with the market data team on front\-office\-facing issues, sharing triage and root cause rather than passing tickets between functions.


 Lead and influence
   

  

* Partner with quant developers and risk engineers to make reliability a design input rather than a post\-launch concern.
* Mentor engineers on incident triage, investigation technique and on\-call practice, and set the standards for automation and operational readiness.
* Contribute to production readiness reviews for new services and client onboardings.
* Support client escalations on risk and analytics output, and be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Document architecture, runbooks and failure modes.


 What you'll bring
   

  

**Required**
* 7\+ years in software engineering for a business\-critical platform, with real ownership of services.
* Strong Python, plus shell. You must be comfortable reading and debugging application code to find root cause — this role is not runbook execution.
* Demonstrated troubleshooting depth — working from a vague client symptom through logs, job histories, data and code to a precise diagnosis.
* Hands\-on experience operating batch and scheduled workloads at scale, including workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Step Functions or equivalent).
* Solid grounding in distributed systems — you can reason about partial failure, retries, idempotency, consistency, and queue and backpressure behaviour under load.
* Working knowledge of AWS — enough to operate applications confidently (compute, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, basic networking) and to tell an infrastructure problem from an application one.
* Practical NoSQL experience (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra or similar): data modelling, indexing, replication and performance troubleshooting.
* Observability in practice — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry or equivalent — and sensible alert design.
* On\-call experience with structured escalation and postmortem writing, and the judgement to lead an incident rather than only participate in one.
* A general understanding of financial systems and genuine appetite to learn the business. You should be able to hold a conversation about what a valuation or a risk number is for, and be willing to go deeper.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Degree (B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MSc) in computer science, engineering or a related field.


**Preferred**
* Experience with timeseries data at scale — storage and partitioning strategies, retention, and query patterns for large historical datasets.
* Experience supporting trading systems, order management systems, risk management systems or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with financial data concepts — instrument reference data, curves and fixings, corporate actions, EOD valuation cycles, VaR and sensitivities.
* Kubernetes and containerised workloads in production, from an operations perspective.
* Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI — enough to make and review changes when the work calls for it.
* Streaming and event\-driven infrastructure (Kafka, Kinesis, MSK) and distributed compute (Spark, EMR, Dask, Ray).
* MongoDB Atlas, Redis / ElastiCache, or managed timeseries and analytical stores (Timestream, ClickHouse, Redshift).
* Working in a regulated financial environment — change management, access controls, audit evidence and client\-facing SLAs.
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development and operations tooling — using LLM\-based agents and assistants to build diagnostics, automate investigation and accelerate delivery.
* Experience mentoring engineers and setting operational standards across a team.


 What will make you stand out
   

  

* A track record of turning a fragile, hand\-held process into a stable service with measurably less manual intervention.
* Experience designing automated recovery, failover and monitoring specifically for analytics or compute\-heavy batch jobs.
* Tooling you built that measurably shortened time\-to\-diagnosis — and a view on where AI\-assisted tooling genuinely helps in an operations context and where it does not.
* The ability to translate a technical failure into client impact, and to be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Curiosity about the domain: engineers who ask what the model is doing and why the number matters build far better reliability into these systems.

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.

* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.

**Desired Skills**

Oversee key quality functions, provide QA/QC operational support, deliver quality awareness and process training, and ensure the effective and sustainable implementation of the QMS in alignment with customer, industry, and NOV Global Quality/BPA/Standardization standards, as well as other applicable requirements.
   

  

 Collaborate closely with the Operations Team, Department Leads, and Process Owners to achieve product quality and on\-time delivery objectives, while driving quality awareness, promotion, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**
* Lead and oversee daily QA/QC operations to ensure compliance with company, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Review Work Orders and Sales Orders to develop Quality Plans (QP), Inspection \& Test Plans (ITP), quality certificates, and data books.
* Plan and coordinate inspections and testing activities including receiving, in\-process, and final inspections, documentation review, functional testing, and FAT witnessing at internal facilities and customer/supplier sites.
* Monitor inspection and testing processes to ensure adherence to applicable quality standards and procedures.
* Ensure proper documentation, traceability, and maintenance of quality records within the document management system.
* Manage NCRs, CARs/PARs, and customer feedback; lead root cause analysis (RCA), corrective action implementation, and timely closure.
* Lead internal quality audits (IQA), support BPA process audits, QMS certification audits, customer audits, and supplier audits as assigned.
* Review and update site\-specific quality procedures to maintain compliance with Global Quality standards and QMS requirements.
* Prepare and present annual quality performance reports.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance QA/QC effectiveness and optimize quality resources.
* Supervise, coach, and develop QA/QC personnel, including performance management and training.
* Ensure full compliance with company Quality and HSE policies.
* Perform other duties as assigned


**Facility/Group Specific Responsibilities**
* Plan and coordinate QC activities at the facility and customer\-designated locations (e.g., shipyards) to ensure project and contractual compliance.
* Maintain and support the site’s QMS certification, ensuring effective implementation and continuous improvement of quality systems and documentation.
* Plan and coordinate QMS, BPA, technical, and surveillance audits with certification bodies, surveyors, customers, and Global Quality representatives.
* Prepare Quality Plans (QP) and Inspection \& Test Plans (ITP), ensuring all drawings, engineering procedures, specifications, and SOPs align with the Repair SOW and customer requirements.
* Manage and document internal and external quality feedback (NCR, CAR/PAR, improvement actions), participate in root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure timely implementation and closure of corrective actions.
* Ensure timely issuance of quality certificates (e.g., COC, SOF, COS) and data books in accordance with Repair WO/SO requirements.
* Review NDE, special process, and inspection/test reports (e.g., coating/painting, welding, PWHT, NDE, calibration, testing) to ensure compliance with approved standards and procedures.

 Job Purpose/Background: The Associate – Aladdin Quality Engineering (AQE) will support the coordination, execution, and ownership of quality strategy, automation, and engineering excellence across Aladdin platforms, with a strong focus on Wealth management, Asset Management workflows spanning multiple facets of Asset management.

* Analyse test results and drive defect resolution by investigating failures, reporting issues clearly, and supporting continuous quality improvement initiatives.


**Test Engineering \& Framework Design**
* Own and evolve test framework architecture, including UI automation – Playwright (preferred), Selenium
* API \& backend testing – including but not limited to API’s and Messaging services.

* Implement robust error reporting, failure analysis, and test result assurance mechanisms.
* Solid understanding of one or more programming languages – TypeScript ( preferred), Java , C\#, Go etc.


**AI Driven Quality Engineering**
* Actively leverage Artificial Intelligence to enable and enhance acceleration of testing cycles – by improving test design, execution and to overall product quality.
* Ability to intelligently use AI to augment the overall test automation cycle – including but not limited to optimal code generation, coverage and maintenance optimisation.
* Should be able to apply AI insights and understanding for additional automation tasks like failure analysis/categorisation, root cause analysis etc.
* Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies and industry trends to continuously identify opportunities for innovation within Quality Engineering.
* Should possess ability and zeal to contribute to AI\-first quality engineering practices , adopting and promoting tools and techniques that enhance team productivity and testing effectiveness – like Spec Engineering, Token Optimisation etc.


**Required Skills / Experience:**
 The candidate is encouraged to possess and be able to demonstrate the following:
   

  

* B.E. / B.Tech. / MCA degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related subject area
* 4\+ years of proven experience in Software Quality Assurance in a financial services firm (e.g., Investment Banking, Asset Management), including writing manual tests (positive and negative), test automation development and execution.
* Good exposure with Testing methodologies, Test plan, Test strategy, RTM and Test estimation etc. with experience in UI testing

 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth.  At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills

description:
Seeking a Validation Engineer (2–4 years exp) in Mechanical, Electronics, or Mechatronics to lead motor and gearbox performance testing, build test setups, and execute DVP\&R validation plans.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Join our engineering team as a Validation Engineer to drive performance, reliability, and quality across our advanced motor and gearbox product lines. In this hands\-on role, you will bridge R\&D and production by specifying dynamometers and test setups, executing end\-to\-end validation protocols (torque\-speed mapping, efficiency, thermal rise, backlash, and noise/vibration), and conducting root\-cause failure investigations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work closely with Design/R\&D, Manufacturing, Quality, and Reliability teams.
* Provide feedback to design engineers on improvements for design\-for\-testability and design\-for\-reliability.
* Collaborate with design/R\&D teams to implement corrective actions.
* Design or specify test benches/dynamometers for motor performance testing (torque\-speed curves, efficiency mapping, back\-EMF, cogging torque).
* Motor testing: torque\-speed characteristics, efficiency, current draw, commutation accuracy (for BLDC/stepper), synchronous behavior, thermal rise, back\-EMF waveform, cogging/ripple torque.
* Investigate test failures (e.g., bearing failures, winding insulation breakdown, gear tooth pitting/wear, demagnetization).
* Plan validation across product lifecycle stages: component, sub\-system, and full assembly levels.
* Gearbox testing: efficiency, backlash, noise/vibration, lubrication effectiveness, gear tooth wear, thermal performance.
* Prepare validation test reports, DVP\&R sign\-off documents, and engineering change validation records.
* Support certification processes (EMI/EMC testing, safety testing).
* Maintain test data traceability and validation history for audits (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 if automotive\-adjacent).
* Define pass/fail criteria based on design specs, customer requirements, and standards (IEC 60034, NEMA, ISO, AGMA for gears, etc.).
* Continuously update technical knowledge and stay current with industry trends, design practices, and software tools.
* Participate in internal training sessions and support knowledge sharing within the team.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
 Experience: 2 \- 4 years
   

  

 Qualification: B.E. / Diploma in Mechanical / Electronics / Mechtronics
   

  

 APPLY NOW
